title: AuthZed June 2026 Release
summary: Remove authorization bottlenecks, empower your team to innovate and expand with best-in-class performance at any scale.
body_markdown:
This release cycle focuses on SpiceDB correctness and operability: case-sensitive identifiers on MySQL, more reliable Watch checkpoints, and a security fix for permission checks that use caveats.


---


### SpiceDB


#### Security Fix ([v1.54.0](https://github.com/authzed/spicedb/releases/tag/v1.54.0) )


Under concurrent load, some permission checks on schemas that combine caveats with intersections (` &` ) or exclusions (` -` ) could return a full permission when the correct answer was a conditional one. See[GHSA-4vrg-r928-h5vv](https://github.com/authzed/spicedb/security/advisories/GHSA-4vrg-r928-h5vv) to check whether your schema is affected. We recommend upgrading.


#### MySQL: Case-Sensitive Identifiers ([v1.54.0](https://github.com/authzed/spicedb/releases/tag/v1.54.0) )


On MySQL, object and subject IDs are now case-sensitive, matching every other SpiceDB datastore. Previously, IDs that differed only in letter case (for example,` Foo` and` foo` ) could collide.


**Upgrade note:** this migration rebuilds the relationships table and can lock it for a long time on large datasets. Run the upgrade in a low-traffic window, or apply it with an online schema-change tool.


#### Reliability Fixes and Improvements ([v1.54.0](https://github.com/authzed/spicedb/releases/tag/v1.54.0) )


- **Watch API** : more dependable checkpoints on MemDB and MySQL.
- **Schema caching** : the experimental watching schema cache now recovers from temporary errors.
- **CockroachDB** : losing one database node no longer briefly blocks reads.
- **Caching** : SpiceDB now uses a single, newer cache implementation.
- **Tracing** : works with less configuration and no longer drops traces on shutdown.
- **Regressions** : fixed issues introduced in v1.53.0 on Postgres and MySQL.
- **Developer experience** : editor hover and go-to-definition now work inside arrow expressions, and Go applications that embed SpiceDB get the same defaults as the CLI.
- **Query planner** : continued progress on the experimental query planner, which is still not recommended for production.


---


### Zed CLI


#### Backup Improvements ([v1.2.0](https://github.com/authzed/zed/releases/tag/v1.2.0) )


` zed backup create` now supports streaming to stdout. When no path is given, the backup is written to the current directory and the saved path is printed.
